Practical consequences for the target world:
- CC BY-NC-SA 2.0 = Attribution + NonCommercial + ShareAlike. A public
  VRChat world counts as non-commercial use, but you must credit PiMaker
  and any derivatives must stay BY-NC-SA.
- Do not copy official Dial assets into a private paid commission without
  contacting the author.
- Full license text staged as LICENSE-CC-BY-NC-SA-2.0.txt (rendered from the
  official Creative Commons legal-code page, fetched 2026-10-01).

rvc itself is MIT (LICENSE already imported under
Assets/ThirdParty/PiMaker/rvc/LICENSE) and is unrelated to these terms.
